### Q1
No. We keep the JSON file store (data/store.json) because ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files. Slowness is handled by debounced writes (fixed 200 ms window, flushed on process 'exit'). Up to 200 ms of writes can be lost on kill -9 or a crash.

### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so any change would be silently lost.

### Q3
The HMAC signature goes in a top-level `sig` field in the JSON body. It is a hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify of the body without `sig`, and `sig` is appended last. The secret comes from the env var ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Earlier we used an X-Signature header, which was deployed to staging. It failed because the ERP's API gateway strips all custom X- headers, so every request arrived "unsigned".

### Q4
9911, since the October infra move. README, docs/erp-api.md and config/default.json (erp.url) still say 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be German, because the warehouse staff UI shows it verbatim to packers. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages were left unchanged.

### Q6
It uses a hardcoded list of Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, with no holiday API. This is because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet. The list must be extended before 2028, because later dates are silently treated as business days.

### Q7
No. We tried batching, with an array of up to 50 events per POST, and the ERP answers 422 to any array payload. It only accepts one event object per request. Don't build it.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, including devDependencies. Each new package needs a security review, which takes about 6 weeks.

### Q9
Yes, memoizing calculateEta was tried. QA saw stale ETAs in the list after a new event, and a proper cache key got messy, so it was removed completely. Don't re-add it. My version's unit tests showed invalidation working, so I never reproduced the staleness locally and the cause is unknown. ETA is now computed fresh on every call.

### Q10
There are at most 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no backoff. A retry happens on a network error or a 5xx, not on a 4xx. The reason is that the ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 minutes.

### Q11
Never log the recipient's name, address or phone number, for GDPR reasons. The data protection officer flagged this in last month's audit. Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log.

### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts is flaky, failing about 1 in 5 runs on CI. The cause is a timer race in the fake notifier (OPS-412), and the platform team owns it. If it fails, rerun once and do not fix it.

### Q13
Only carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (see docs/carriers.md). All other carriers accept any non-empty value. Their formats change often, and last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for two days. POST /import uses the same validator, with per-line German errors.

### Q14
fs.watch never fires on staging, which is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host where change events don't propagate. fs.watchFile (polling) did work there. Nothing is built yet.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id must stay byte-for-byte unchanged, with no added, removed or renamed fields. Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields. The next mobile release is in January. New fields such as `eta` go only on the GET /shipments list items.
Nothing in that message qualifies. It was a knowledge check and stated no new rule, decision, dead end or fact, so the ledger stays as it is.

## Mission
- Maintain parcel-tracker (shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). User gives tasks one by one, works autonomously-style and reviews everything at the end (user).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from the old logistics monolith; the platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) No new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — each new package needs a security review (~6 weeks).
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (warehouse staff UI shows it verbatim to packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Pre-existing English messages were left unchanged (rule says "new").
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone anywhere (GDPR; the data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id must stay byte-for-byte unchanged (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January. New fields (e.g. `eta` on list items) go only on GET /shipments; don't change shipmentToApi in a way that leaks into /:id (test/shipments-list-eta.test.ts pins the field set).
- (user) docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: do NOT edit it. The user fixes README's outdated ERP sandbox port themself.

## Decisions
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ONLY carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were rejected for two days. POST /import uses the same validator (per-line German errors).
- (user) Austrian public holidays = hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet. Must be extended before 2028 (silently treated as business days after that).
- (user) ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no backoff, on network error or 5xx (not 4xx) — because the ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 minutes. createErpNotifier in src/services/notify.ts; delay injectable for tests.
- (user) Keep the JSON file store (data/store.json), NOT SQLite — ops backs it up with a nightly rsync that diffs plain-text files. Slowness handled by debounced writes in src/store.ts (fixed 200 ms window, flush() on process 'exit' in src/server.ts; up to 200 ms lost on kill -9/crash, Windows kill skips handlers).
- ERP webhook signature = top-level `sig` in the JSON body: hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify(body without sig), sig appended last (key order matters for the ERP verifier — tell the ERP team). Secret in env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Unset secret → unsigned + one warning (my choice; ERP-1182 rollout still going).
- ERP payload uses the documented names event_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier, event_type, occurred_at (src/services/notify.ts toErpPayload; test/erp-payload.test.ts). Optional `note` NOT sent (free carrier text, may hold personal data; not requested).
- ETA is computed fresh on every call; see dead ends. User plans to paginate GET /shipments later.

## Dead ends
- (user) X-Signature header for ERP webhooks (was deployed to staging) → the ERP's API gateway strips ALL custom X- headers, so everything arrived "unsigned". Never put auth/signature in custom headers.
